item.title: The 10 Best Horror Books of All Time According to Goodreads, Ranked
item.description: Horror is an extremely broad genre, spanning supernatural tales and stories of mundane but twisted killers. It can be tinged with romance, fused with sci-fi , or focused on mystery. Everyone has their own fears, so choosing the most effective horror novels is a daunting task. We’ve turned to the wisdom of the crowd by consulting Goodreads, whose millions of members have rated the books that keep them up at night, and it turns out they really like Stephen King. Here’s a ranked list of the top 10 books they chose and why you should read them this spooky season.

item.title: Stephen King and Stanley Kubrick's Near-Perfect Psychological Thriller Is Officially Back on Streaming
item.description: Stephen King is a vocal guy. The Master of Horror has published over 65 novels and novellas, countless short stories, and five nonfiction books since the mid-’70s. The hype that surrounds him is well deserved. King is the kind of writer who appeals to everyone, whether you’re a genre enthusiast or a literary snob. His work has been adapted into TV shows and films, and he’s never afraid to voice his complaints and praise in equal measure. But there’s one adaptational grudge that towers above all.

item.title: 60 Years Ago, the Best Charlie Brown Quote Was So Perfect It Made It Into the Movie
item.description: Lucy’s quote, “Happiness is a warm puppy,” is another great one that touches on life’s simple joys on a really deep level. But to determine the best quote ever uttered by Charlie Brown, I didn't want accidental brilliance, I wanted something that he understands as much as the audience does. Something where he’s telling you who he is with complete self awareness. I wanted the character's philosophy on life. To me, that’s the difference between a brilliant Charlie Brown quote and brilliant Charles Schulz quote, if that makes sense.

item.title: 42 Years Later, the Definitive Sci-Fi Action Thriller is Free to Watch on YouTube
item.description: Terminator 2: Judgment Day is the rare sequel where just about everybody likes it better than the original. That’s for good reason. The 1991 sci-fi action thriller redefined the blockbuster with a relentlessly exciting story, mind-blowing special effects, and the superstar presence of Arnold Schwarzenegger. The movie is so good it often outshines its predecessor, which also redefined the action thriller in the 1980s and is still exhilarating to watch for an entirely different reason than its sequel.

item.title: GTA: San Andreas’ Bigfoot myth is a classic urban legend
item.description: There is a Bigfoot in Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas — at least, that's what I and many others believed. Some time after the game had been released, the rumour about the new Rockstar game featuring the legendary creature spread across the internet. I remember learning about this "secret monster" from an older guy. Then I told some boys from my classroom the cool rumor I had heard about in that game our parents didn't want us to play. Word of mouth and low-resolution images shared through dial-up internet connections made GTA: San Andreas an exciting mystery.

item.title: Game of Thrones Prequel The Mad King Officially Returns in 2027
item.description: The Mad King lives. The Royal Shakespeare Company's sold-out stage production of Game of Thrones: The Mad King closed in Stratford-upon-Avon in September, but it's not the end for the spinoff of George R.R. Martin's prequel to Game of Thrones .

item.title: 44 Years Later, Steven Spielberg's Scariest Movie of All Time Is Officially Back on Streaming
item.description: Poltergeist , which is currently available to stream on HBO Max, follows an ordinary suburban family who begin to experience strange things in their home. Furniture and toys move on their own, a glass of milk shatters out of nowhere, and the youngest child in the family, five-year-old Carol Anne (Heather O'Rourke), begins to communicate with beings through the television. At first these events are dismissed, but during a thunderstorm one night, a tree outside the windows of the kids’ room crashes in and snatches the boy. Then, a portal opens in their closet, sucking Carol Anne into another dimension. With help from some paranormal investigators, the family tries everything to bring her back.

item.title: 8 Most Disappointing Switch Games, Ranked
item.description: They say that happiness equals reality minus expectations, and, unfortunately for these eight Switch games, reality landed nowhere near what was expected. It’s hard to blame the critical and community reception for some of them, but not all of them are bad. Some just aren’t what people were hoping they would be. So we’ve ranked them by the size of the gap between promise and result, from the mild letdowns to the ones that stung most or didn’t justify for the cost. Consider this your reminder to check your expectations at the door.

item.title: Pokémon Go Minior Shower schedule
item.description: The meteor Pokémon, Minior , is making its Pokémon Go debut with its many colorful cores, but it'll only be available during real-life meteor showers. You'll want to keep your eyes peeled for these little critters during these rare moments throughout the year, and keep an extra watchful eye in the evening, as these will appear more frequently. To assist with this, we've put together a Minior schedule, so you know exactly when to look out for these.
